'''Knuckles''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Breakout Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served in the [[Mission to Kynachi]]. In the shuttle to [[Kynachi]], he beat the rest of Breakout Squad in a push up contest, and [[Chatterbox]] came second place. Upon leaving Kynachi, Knuckles joined Breakout Squad led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]]. Their next mission was to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] to discuss a possible alliance. They escaped a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] attack but became trapped by a Black Hole. Knuckles and Breakout Squad found an [[Infinity Gate|ancient artifact]] and used it to escape. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] then asked them to escort [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They met the Commissioner on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]], but he was quickly [[Mission to Vaced|assassinated]]. Breakout Squad chased after the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], who apparently [[Death/Legends|died]] in the fight. Kungurama then led Breakout Squad to [[Bilbringi Depot]], where they [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|clashed with the Techno Union]]. During the investigation, they discovered that the Sommilor who had been killed on Vaced was an [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|impostor]]. Breakout Squad returned to Coruscant, where Kungurama confronted his missing master, [[Ring-Sol Ambase]]. Breakout Squad, including Knuckles, was later assigned to investigate the disappearance of the [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']]. Knuckles and the squad later joined up with Kungurama for a mission to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. There they defeated the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]] and then rescued orphaned [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] on [[Foless/Legends|Foless]].

==Biography==
===Breakout Squad's formation===
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] known as Knuckles<ref name="SM1" /> was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB" /> He wore his [[Color/Legends|black]] hair cropped short.<ref name="Strange Allies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> was assigned to [[Mission to Kynachi|investigate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]]. On the way, the clones conducted a push-up contest, which Knuckles handily won. Their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was ambushed by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and destroyed. Along with Ambase's stowaway [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nuru Kungurama]], the surviving [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] took an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to the surface. They eventually liberated the [[Planet/Legends|world]] from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]], earning themselves the moniker of [[Breakout Squad]]. They were able to acquire [[Transport/Legends|transport]] back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lalo Gunn]] and her ship the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''.<ref name="SM1" />

===Lost in the black hole===
En route, they received orders from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to go to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] for a meeting at [[Defense Fleet Command|Defense Station]] [[Ifpe'a]]. They met the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Diplomat/Legends|representative]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]] to discuss an alliance, and rescued her from a Techno Union attack led by Overseer Umbrag. After escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], they became trapped near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. Kungurama and Breakout Squad managed to locate an ancient [[Infinity Gate]] with a pair of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] and use it to escape the black hole. The Aristocra returned home while Breakout Squad continued back to Coruscant.<ref name="SM2">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>

===Chase on Vaced===
{{Quote|Something just occurred to me. When we return to Coruscant, I doubt the Council will encourage me to continue serving with Breakout Squad. I'm sure they'll assign you to a more experienced leader. I just want you all to know I've learned a great deal from you, and...and I'll miss you all very much.|Nuru Kungurama to Breakout Squad on Bilbringi Depot|<ref name="SM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>}}
During the trip back to Coruscant, Breakout Squad was contacted by Chancellor Palpatine again and asked to [[Mission to Vaced|divert]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] and escort him to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital. Breakout Squad arrived first and met the Commissioner upon his arrival, but he was quickly [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. Kungurama ordered Knuckles and Breakout Squad to secure the perimeter, while the Jedi pursued the sniper. The clones got onboard Gunn's ship while Kungurama took a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike. The sniper, a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], managed outfight Kungurama and reach his [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|transport]]. He then engaged the ''Hasty Harpy,'' causing both ships to crash and leading his apparent [[Death/Legends|death]]. After Breakout Squad and Gunn decided to part ways, Kungurama found an imagecaster which led Breakout Squad to take Sommilor's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]], where they [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|clashed]] with Umbrag again, and recaptured the depot.<ref name="SM3" />

===Confrontation on Coruscant===
[[File:BilbringiMission-SA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Knuckles and Breakout Squad fighting on Bilbringi.]]
Breakout Squad finished investigating the Depot, and discovered that the Sommilor who had been killed on Vaced was an [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|impostor]]; the real Sommilor was freed from his captivity in the freighter's hold. Knuckle's squadmate [[Chatterbox]] had been wounded in the fight, and clone [[Medic/Legends|medics]] arrived to him, with the rest of Breakout Squad donating [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. The squad then returned to Coruscant with Sommilor. During the trip in hyperspace, Umbrag managed to grab Kungurama and wound their ally [[Gizman|Gizz]], but was shot in the attempt. Knuckles assisted by applying first aid to Gizz. Once on Coruscant, Jedi Master [[Harro Kelpura]] ordered their freighter to change course from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to his lab in [[Dacho District]], which had been broken into. The ship was then damaged by an impact with a [[Sleight of Hand|dropship]] belonging to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The ship crashed, knocking out several of the passengers and cracking Knuckle's helmet. The ship was able to take off and escape, and Kungurama confronted his missing master with Knuckle's help. Five days later, Breakout Squad was assigned to investigate the disappearance of the freighter [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']], which was carrying munitions.<ref name="SM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

===Pirates and younglings===
{{Quote|Did Chancellor Palpatine really believe the Hutt ''wants'' our help, Commander?''"<br />"''I doubt the Chancellor would have encouraged this mission otherwise, Knuckles.|Knuckles to Nuru Kungurama on their mission to Affa|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
Breakout Squad was next assembled for a mission to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. When they arrived at the rendezvous on [[Affa/Legends|Affa]], they discovered the remains of a massacre. They continued their mission to Fondor, where they [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|defeated]] the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]]. Once there, Gizz befriended a blind [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Kuvuta Pindi]]. Kungurama agreed to help her escort orphaned [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. Once there, they realized Pindi was trying to steal the orphans, and gave chase. Breakout Squad Pundar and freed the younglings, but Pindi was killed.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
Knuckles did push-ups to the point that another clone commented that he did them in his sleep.<ref name="SM1" /> He wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|gray]] Breakout Squad markings and used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Knuckles appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers series, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]''. He and Breakout Squad was first pictured in the comic [[Opress Unleashed|''The Clone Wars: Opress Unleashed'']], a comic released in [[2011]] as part of [[Free Comic Book Day]] and later included in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''.
